Here is the analysis and reasoning for each question:

1. **[000c853a-7896-439c-af8f-83f93a94aa21-146810]**: For $f(x) = \sqrt{x-2}$ to be defined in real numbers, $x - 2 \ge 0 \implies x \ge 2$. Thus, the domain is $[2, \infty)$. **(D)**
2. **[018777f7-7958-4668-95af-70afe6cf7e66-103354]**: Average speed for equal distance trips is given by the harmonic mean: $\frac{2 \times 5 \times 3}{5 + 3} = \frac{30}{8} = \frac{15}{4}$ km/h. **(A)**
3. **[01e79fd1-255b-4857-96fc-59c1f17df04c-15675]**: In Bangladesh, the rural local government structure has 3 tiers (Union Parishad, Upazila Parishad, and Zila Parishad). **(A)**
4. **[0269a96c-32f5-477c-bab9-31fd827929f3-51190]**: George Boole (জর্জ বুল) is the inventor of Boolean logic/algebra. **(C)**
5. **[0328368d-9139-4f5e-b75b-2eae817dba6d-119686]**: A seconds pendulum has a time period $T = 2\text{ s}$, so its frequency $f = \frac{1}{T} = 0.5\text{ Hz}$. **(C)**
6. **[034aa277-1099-4156-bd75-02abc0eca393-64103]**: The red-orange pigment responsible for henna coloring is lawsone (লাসোন). **(D)**
7. **[03a5ee94-d39c-4a25-94f3-d20bc8197d6e-141978]**: Roots typically lack a hypodermis (অধঃত্বক অনুপস্থিত). Stating that roots have a hypodermis ("অধঃত্বক আছে") is incorrect. **(C)**
8. **[064a8667-f1ca-4d1a-8459-11db81ef4a69-131760]**: The quasi-passive form of "The pill tastes bitter" in the present tense is "The pill is bitter when it is tasted." **(D)**
9. **[0720a5e2-aa79-49f6-9ed2-98f8473d1fb6-139424]**: The idiomatic English translation is "Fortunately I could get into the next bus." **(A)**
10. **[084c3183-b891-4cae-bca9-e9b73a923003-48454]**: The distance a screw penetrates depends strictly on pitch and number of rotations. Since both screws are identical and need to penetrate the same depth, both must be rotated the exact same number of times. **(C)**
11. **[08bd4ed2-6c89-43d1-91b6-6e7e4695bede-122115]**: Hamidur Rahman is the main designer and architect of the Central Shaheed Minar. **(A)**
12. **[08de5d58-d002-429c-ba6c-c49610eea192-102317]**: Polarity is a well-known characteristic of polar covalent compounds, so stating that polarity is not a characteristic of covalent compounds is false. **(D)**
13. **[09255f80-0720-46f4-ae96-f013ca5a79fb-108294]**: Resonance is a special case of forced vibration (পরবশ কম্পন), which causes severe building damage during earthquakes. **(A)**
14. **[09771521-ceb8-449f-bced-46bb53d91cf7-63413]**: "Inexorable" means relentless or unyielding (অনমনীয়). **(B)**
15. **[0a88ac8c-fb49-46ae-a2fe-9c449a16c780-105528]**: The horizontal range of a projectile $R = \frac{v^2 \sin(2\theta)}{g}$ is maximized when $\sin(2\theta) = 1 \implies \theta = 45^\circ$. **(B)**
